title: lobelia tomentosa var. ceratophylla
intro: Lobelia tomentosa var. ceratophylla, commonly known as Indian tobacco, is a plant species within the Campanulaceae family, known for its medicinal properties and adaptogenic effects. The health benefits of Lobelia tomentosa var. ceratophylla include its ability to help alleviate anxiety, stress, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful for respiratory conditions, such as asthma and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Lobelia tomentosa var. ceratophylla include lobeline, lobelanine, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
